notes.title: Full Tilt to be upgraded to Jackpot Poker by PokerStars on Steam Platform
notes.content:
The Full Tilt game is due to be upgraded to our Jackpot Poker by PokerStars offering over the coming months. 

Jackpot Poker by PokerStars has a number of features that we believe offer Steam players a heightened poker experience, with an emphasis on creating a more fun and challenging poker journey for a wider range of players. 

Full Tilt Poker will continue to be accessible over the coming weeks, however in-app purchase payments from the Steam Wallet will cease with immediate effect. 

We will announce further details of the launch of Jackpot Poker by PokerStars as we prepare the game for the Steam platform in the coming months. 

Purchasers of chips within the Full Tilt game will be contacted directly by our team shortly.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Full Tilt Poker
notes.content:
Full Tilt Poker is Now Available on Steam!

Experience the very best in online poker at our free-to-play No Limit Hold’em poker tables and discover new game types including: Rush Poker, Jackpot Sit & Go or Multi-Table Tournaments. You can also play Omaha, Razz, Stud and Draw. An authentic Poker experience awaits for beginners or pros.
